correctness.rationale: The finite-local decomposition is q disjoint K_m components in residue characteristic two and one K_m plus (q-1)/2 disjoint K_{m,m} components in odd residue characteristic. Component automorphisms give the displayed groups. Twin permutations force m-1 determining vertices per clique or bipartition class and the matching constructions attain q(m-1). The m-color lower bounds for distinguishing labelings are sharp; m>=q follows from nonzero m/m^2 over the residue field and makes m+1 colors sufficient. Direct modular examples and exhaustive small automorphism checks replay successfully.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the complete graph-symmetry group and two standard symmetry-breaking invariants for every finite commutative local nonfield. The coincidence of uniform formulas across the characteristic-two and odd decompositions is structurally informative, and D=m+1 recovers the maximal-ideal size directly from the graph symmetry profile.
